baselinePrompt:
[INFLUENCER] is shirtless in a tropical infinity pool, wearing navy blue swim shorts with white drawstring and white trim along the hem, a black wide-brim bucket hat with "miu miu" branding on the front panel, a thin silver chain necklace, a black smartwatch on one wrist, and a silver bracelet-style watch on the other. He begins completely submerged to chest level in the still turquoise water, his chin slightly tucked downward, gazing down with a relaxed, unhurried expression. The pool's stone coping ledge runs horizontally across the very bottom of the frame. Behind him the infinity edge dissolves into a lush green tropical hillside below a pale hazy midday sky, a single rounded mountain peak rising softly in the centre background. No other people are present.

The video opens on this low, still shot — [INFLUENCER]'s upper chest and head barely clearing the waterline, the bucket hat brim casting a shadow across his face, wide open sky dominating the top two-thirds of the frame. The camera holds at this level, shooting straight on, lens approximately at pool-water height, so the infinity edge acts as a natural horizon line.

He then begins rising slowly and deliberately out of the water at a natural walking pace, stepping forward toward the pool ledge. Water streams and cascades off his torso and shorts as he lifts clear of the surface, small splashes bursting around his thighs and calves with each upward step. He tilts and turns his head gradually from side to side — looking left, then glancing down, then shifting right — in an unhurried, almost meditative way, never looking directly at the camera. His hands rest loose at his sides or grip lightly at the hem of his shorts as water drains out in rivulets. The ascent is continuous and steady, progressively revealing more of his torso and legs with each step, the waterline dropping from chest to waist to thigh to knee as he climbs out. By the final frames he is largely clear of the water, standing at the ledge, head still slightly bowed, hat brim angled down.

The camera remains locked off on a fixed lens throughout — no panning, no zooming, no tracking. The only visual movement is [INFLUENCER] rising through the frame. Lighting is bright tropical midday sun, high and slightly overcast, producing a clean wash of natural light with soft shadows, the background slightly blown out toward a pale sky. The overall mood is unhurried, sun-drenched, quietly confident.
